text:
Maria (CS): Heads-up — Equinox FinTech is running a payment simulator pilot tomorrow and needs a temporary regional routing change + IP allowlist. They want a 3x QPS bump for 48h starting 2026-03-28 08:00 BRT. Also flagged renewal risk next month, please advise.

Sam (AM): Noted. Can you share exact QPS target and IPs? Renewal date? Looping Raj + Lei.

Maria (CS): Target: 120 QPS sustained (they're at ~40 now). IP ranges: 18.234.120.0/24 and 18.234.121.0/25. Pilot window: 2026-03-28 08:00-20:00 BRT (primary). Renewal: contract renewal 2026-04-15 — moderate risk if pilot has issues.

Raj (Infra): We can do a temporary burst policy on the Dedicated pool and provision peering. Will open infra ticket — need confirmation on ASN & peering contact. Any preference for which edge? Sao Paulo preferred.

Lei (Network): Can add IPs to allowlist and stage a peering config. Julia — can you share ASN and netops contact? Also need to know whether they want source IP NAT preserved.

Julia (Equinox): ASN is 64501. Peering contact: netops@equinox.com. IPs above are correct. We want source IP preserved (no NAT) for telemetry. We'll need per-request logs during the test.

Carlos (Support): We can enable verbose per-request logs and a temporary debug flag for 48h. I'll prepare a short KB for their SRE and a runbook for fallbacks.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4821 to provision burst capacity, add peering, and update route rules.

Raj (Infra): Linked INFRA-4821. ETA: config changes can be staged and pushed ~6h before window. Need a DNS failover plan and a config push at ~07:30 BRT on the day. @Lei please confirm scheduling.

Lei (Network): :thumbsup: Scheduling config push for 2026-03-28 07:30 BRT. Will also add the allowlist entries and a temporary route rule. Config snippet I'm going to apply:
```
route_rule: match(host: "*.equinox.com") -> backend: sa-east-1
qos: spike_allow: 200
allowlist: - 18.234.120.0/24 - 18.234.121.0/25
```

Maria (CS): I've scheduled an enablement session with Equinox SRE on 2026-03-27 10:00 PT to walk through fallbacks, logging, and metrics. Sam — can you prepare renewal-facing notes and success criteria for the pilot? They raised questions about latency and unit cost.

Sam (AM): On it. I'll prepare an executive summary, pilot success criteria (latency p50/p95 targets, error rate threshold, and cost delta), and propose a reserved pricing incentive if they sign at renewal.

Julia (Equinox): Appreciate it. Also collecting feedback: they'd like clearer SLA language for region failover and per-route cost visibility. We'll capture notes during the enablement.

Maria (CS): Noted — adding to follow-up doc and to INFRA-4821. After the pilot we'll collect latency percentiles, request logs, and a cost breakdown to share back with Equinox.

Raj (Infra): Will update INFRA-4821 with post-test metrics and any infra anomalies.

Maria (CS): Closing loop for now — configs being staged, peering/contact info captured, enablement scheduled, and renewal/feedback items assigned. I'll update thread with final confirmation when the config push is complete. Thanks everyone.
